_README: Selectors for the optional PropertyRadar Sold/Listed verification step.
Purpose: before texting, look the property up in PropertyRadar and confirm
it is not Sold or Listed. If PropertyRadar says sold/listed, the lead is
dispositioned accordingly and NOT texted. If PropertyRadar can't be read,
the REI BlackBook status is used instead (this step never forces a text).
STATUS: NEEDS-DOM everywhere below - these are best-guess placeholders from
the Discover screenshot. Verify each against the live PropertyRadar account
before enabling. Playwright selector engines allowed: CSS, 'text=...', ':has-text()'.

search._status: NEEDS-DOM - Discover screen shows a 'Full Address' quick search and a City/County/ZIP box
search.resultLink: .result-row a, table tbody tr a, .property-card a

status._status: NEEDS-DOM - property detail status. Capture a sold and a listed property to confirm.
status.listedMarker: text=Listed, text=For Sale, text=Active Listing, text=On Market
